# BestAIAgent.in — Machine-readable site map

## Site identity
Canonical: https://bestaiagent.in/
Language: en-IN
Purpose: independent AI agent discovery and evidence-led comparison.

## Primary user journeys
1. Discover agents by task or category.
2. Compare products inside a shared user workflow before crossing categories.
3. Inspect first-party evidence and review dates for material product claims.
4. Evaluate India-specific adoption context separately from global product capability.
5. Learn how agentic workflows, coding agents, automation platforms, and related systems differ.

## Priority pillar documents
- https://bestaiagent.in/best-ai-agent
- https://bestaiagent.in/best-ai-agent-for-business
- https://bestaiagent.in/best-ai-agent-for-coding
- https://bestaiagent.in/best-ai-agent-alternatives
- https://bestaiagent.in/best-ai-agents-for-automation

Each pillar contains:
- a direct answer near the top of the page
- a workflow-specific evidence shortlist
- first-party or primary-source links with verification dates
- visible methodology and limitations
- FAQ answers that match visible page content
- BreadcrumbList, ItemList, FAQPage, and WebPage structured data
- no AggregateRating or unsupported universal winner claim

## Canonical discovery surfaces
- Homepage: https://bestaiagent.in/
- Categories: https://bestaiagent.in/categories
- India Fit: https://bestaiagent.in/built-in-india
- Marketplace: https://bestaiagent.in/marketplace
- Resources: https://bestaiagent.in/resources

## Current evidence-backed examples on priority pillars
- Claude Code — Coding — Anthropic documentation
- Cursor — Coding — Cursor product/pricing sources, including official India-specific Cursor Start evidence
- GitHub Copilot — Coding — GitHub Copilot agents documentation
- Lindy — Business — Lindy product/pricing documentation
- n8n — Automation — n8n AI agents product documentation
- AI by Zapier — Automation — Zapier migration and product documentation

## Evaluation signals
- Workflow fit
- First-party evidence quality and freshness
- Integration model
- Deployment model
- Human approval and deterministic controls where relevant
- Pricing and regional availability where directly sourced
- India-specific buying and deployment context

## Editorial safeguards
- Evidence before rankings.
- Products designed for different jobs are not forced into one universal score.
- Unsupported ratings, testimonials, certifications, partnerships, and endorsements are excluded.
- Product facts should be tied to first-party or primary evidence and reviewed periodically.
- INR context must be distinguished from official local pricing; official India pricing is labelled as such only when the vendor publishes it.
- Availability, pricing, capabilities, integrations, and regional support can change after the verification date.
